queries_run: Hilton Worldwide Holdings market share RevPAR index gaining 2026 net unit growth vs Marriott
Hilton new entrant OR competitor threat lodging 2026 conversion brands Wyndham Choice Marriott pipeline share

findings.claim: 10-K 列示主要競爭對手為 Accor、Choice、Hyatt、IHG、Marriott、Wyndham；風險因子提及也與小型連鎖、獨立業者、家庭/公寓分享服務及分時度假業者競爭，並提到 AI 技術落後風險。
findings.excerpt: On a global scale, our primary competitors are Accor S.A., Choice Hotels International, Hyatt Hotels Corporation, Intercontinental Hotel Group, Marriott International and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司與管理及特許合約爭奪戰中，競爭對手可能提供更優條件；亦與家庭與公寓分享服務競爭。
findings.excerpt: We also compete against smaller hotel chains, independent and local hotel owners and operators, home and apartment sharing services and timeshare operators. If we are unable to compete successfully, our revenues or profits may decline.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到 RevPAR index／市占率直接數據；以下 clues 為淨單位成長與管線的搜尋摘要線索（HLT 2026 NUG 指引 6-7% 高於 Marriott 4.5-5%；管線 543,100 間，轉換占 Q3 開業 37%），未核原文。

clues.claim: Hilton 2026 淨單位成長指引 6%–7%，Q1 管線 52.7 萬間，占全球在建客房逾 20%
Hilton 管線達 543,100 間（2026-09-30，年增 5%），轉換占 Q3 開業 37%，CEO 預期 2026 轉換占 30–40%
clues.source: CoStar: Hilton CEO calls on conversions to keep up momentum in 2026

clues.claim: Marriott 2026 淨客房成長指引 4.5%–5%，低於 Hilton 6–7%
clues.source: Yahoo Finance: Marriott reports 4.2% rise in Q1 2026 global RevPAR
